summary: Session 2 shipped the DIRECT_API precondition and the qualified verdict. check_direct_api_precondition() compares the providers whose api_key_env actually resolves against the orchestrator's EFFECTIVE provider (registry-resolved, never a seat label); when a project whose committed verify type is DIRECT_API holds no usable key outside its own orchestrator's provider, route() warns loudly and PROCEEDS with a same-provider verifier instead of hard-blocking into the operator-attested manual path. That permission is derived inside route(), never accepted as an argument, so I-084-S1-3 stays closed and an uncommitted AI_ORCHESTRATION_VERIFY_TYPE cannot weaken anything; the Copilot-seat fail-closed contract is untouched. classify_verification_qualification() is the single mechanism deciding whether a verdict is qualified, and the qualification travels omit-null on the three router-owned records (metrics stamp row, sN-issues.json envelope, disposition.json, the last actively cleared when an unqualified round supersedes a qualified one). The close gate enforces it as a BIJECTION: a same-provider row passes only if it declares itself, and a cross-provider row declaring it is refused, so the flag can be neither missing nor decorative. Deliberately not written to session-state.json (operator decision P4 keeps orchestrator provenance out of the Explorer; the design doc reserved that call). Four verification rounds, six findings, all accepted -- every one of them the same class: the machinery was correct and UNREACHABLE (config load died before the precondition ran; the CLI re-imposed the exclusion route() had lifted; the qualification was dropped by the metrics writer the close gate reads; the disposition JSON Schema rejected the field; disabling a keyless provider left its models selectable). 12 falsifiers; full pytest 3967 passed / 9 skipped.

reason.specifics: Session 3 deletes the webview and rewrites the first-run walkthrough against the terminal setup path Sessions 1-2 built, so it needs live knowledge of what the resolver guarantees and where setup now lives. It is mostly deletion plus a package.json edit paying L-064-12's full Layer 3 run. It should also carry forward this session's config change -- a keyless provider is now disabled rather than fatal -- because that is exactly the state a fresh project is in during the step-2 true cold-start dogfood (L-079-3). No blocker, no capability gap; the verifier stays cross-provider by registry exclusion regardless.
